passes.name: LiftOff Pass
passes.description: Full-day access for developers and community members.
passes.eligibility: Open to everyone. Up to 2 tickets per order, with separate details for each attendee.
passes.summary: Sessions, workshops, lunch and refreshments, DevFest Goodies, and Community, Expert and Exhibit Lounge access. Workshop seats are first come, first served.

passes.name: Cadet Pass
passes.description: Full-day access for college and university students.
passes.eligibility: Currently enrolled students only. Add your college, degree and graduation year at checkout. Bring your original, active physical student photo ID matching your registration. Limit: 1 ticket per order.
passes.note: Without valid student ID, entry may be denied without refund or an upgrade fee may apply. Professionals booking Cadet may face cancellation or need to pay for a Commander upgrade.
passes.summary: Sessions, workshops, lunch and refreshments, DevFest Goodies, and Community, Expert and Exhibit Lounge access. Workshop seats are first come, first served. Student ID required.

passes.name: Commander Pass
passes.eligibility: Working professionals only, including engineers, architects, tech leads, managers and founders. Students must choose Cadet. Register every attendee with their own details.
passes.note: Team discounts and a corporate tax invoice are available at checkout. Check KonfHub for the applicable discount.
passes.summary: Sessions, workshops, lunch and refreshments, DevFest Goodies, and Community, Expert and Exhibit Lounge access. Workshop seats are first come, first served.

passes.name: Flight Deck Pass
passes.description: Additional access for invited founders, technical leaders and ecosystem partners.
passes.eligibility: After booking Cadet or Commander, express interest in Flight Deck. Invitations are limited; booking a standard pass does not guarantee VIP access.
passes.note: Follow the registration instructions in your invitation.
passes.summary: All standard inclusions, plus priority access and lunch with delegates. Refreshments, DevFest Goodies and all three lounges are included. Workshop seats are first come, first served.

passes.name: Last Orbit Pass
passes.description: Late registration, subject to venue capacity.
passes.eligibility: Open to everyone, subject to final venue capacity.
passes.note: Late-booking pricing applies. DevFest Goodies are first come, first served, while supplies last.
passes.summary: Full-day technical sessions and lunch. DevFest Goodies while supplies last.

passes.name: Observer Pass
passes.description: Keynotes and open technical sessions only.
passes.eligibility: Open to community walk-ins and session-only attendees.
passes.note: Lunch, tea, refreshments, workshop hall access and DevFest Goodies are not included.
passes.summary: Keynotes and open sessions. No food, refreshments, workshops or DevFest Goodies.

policies.title: All sales are final
policies.text: Tickets cannot be cancelled, transferred, resold, rescheduled or refunded.

policies.title: Bring your ticket and photo ID
policies.text: Bring your digital QR ticket and an original physical government-issued photo ID matching your registration name for check-in and badge collection.

policies.title: Use each attendee’s own details
policies.text: Enter each attendee’s full name, email, mobile number and LinkedIn URL. Give accurate student or professional details. Organizers may check your information and ID; false or unverifiable details may lead to cancellation or denied entry.

policies.title: Cadet: student ID required
policies.text: Cadet is for currently enrolled college and university students. Bring your original, active physical student photo ID matching your registration, alongside your government photo ID. Without valid proof, entry may be denied without refund or an upgrade fee may apply. Professionals booking Cadet may face cancellation or need to pay for a Commander upgrade.

policies.title: Workshop seats are limited
policies.text: Your pass must include workshop access. Seats depend on capacity and any session-specific registration requirements. A conference ticket does not reserve a workshop seat.

policies.title: What your pass includes
policies.text: Access, meals, refreshments and DevFest Goodies depend on your selected pass. Any first-come, first-served or while-supplies-last condition applies only where stated for that pass.

policies.title: Flight Deck: invitation only
policies.text: Book Cadet or Commander before expressing interest in Flight Deck. Invitations are limited and not guaranteed. Follow the registration instructions in your invitation; expressing interest is not a confirmed registration.

policies.title: Need to correct your details?
policies.text: Contact the organizers before the event. Corrections cannot transfer a ticket or change the attendee’s identity.

policies.title: Respect the community
policies.text: Everyone must follow the code of conduct and organizer instructions. Harassment, disruptive behaviour or other violations may result in a revoked pass or removal without refund.

registrationChecklist.title: Add your LinkedIn URL
registrationChecklist.text: Sign in to KonfHub and add your own LinkedIn profile URL before booking.
